text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
――*pant*, *pant*...!
Chugging down fresh air with deep breaths, complete...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. So the unusual gust turned out to be you.
Are you enjoying some forest bathing today?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Zephyr!
Well, rather than forest bathing, it's more like taking a breather――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? Take a break from Disciplinary Committee duties...
What's the meaning of this, you guys!?

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
Because Committee Chair, lately
you've been working non-stop without any breaks!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Please take a rest once in a while!
We just can't bear watching you overwork yourself like this!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guh, fine, I get it!
If you guys insist that much!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
――And so, today my Disciplinary Committee Chair persona is sealed away!
I came out here to get some proper, genuine rest!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, mountains are an ideal place for serene rest.
Shall we bask in the gentle breeze together, then?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you yield yourself naturally, like a weather vane...
a clear, refreshing wind will surely blow through your heart.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two birds over there! No fighting!!
Share your food amicably and peacefully!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san, please wait.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It may appear harsh to our eyes,
but that is the providence of nature... its established rules.
We should remain mere watchers of the wind.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so!?
I thought discipline was breaking down, so without thinking I just...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh, my Disciplinary Committee habit keeps slipping out...
Resting sure is tough work~.
(*WHOOOOOOSH!*)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
...Ah! Zephyr, look over there!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A newly hatched chick, isn't it...
That sudden squall must have blown it out of its nest.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This must be one of those cases too...
where not interfering is nature's rule, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...B-But I can't just leave it like this!
How could I ignore someone in trouble right before my eyes!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. That is simply the wind that you are.
In that case, let us become a favorable breeze,
so long as we do not disrupt their natural way of life.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...! Thanks a bunch, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To keep our scent from transferring to it,
we can gather fallen leaves to cradle in our hands,
and safely lift the chick back into its nest.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Understood! Let's get right on it right away!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
――And that settles it.
All's well that ends well, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Though I ended up getting all
fired up like usual in the end.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A thermal updraft... if that is the nature of your existence,
there is no need to forcefully oppose it.
After all, that little chick was saved.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Reaching a dead calm is not the only way to rest.
Following wherever the winds of your heart blow... that is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I'll stay true to who I am!
I'm gonna spend the rest of my time off just as I please!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mnnnhhh~~!!
Somehow I feel super refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems a clear breeze has blown through.
I am glad it turned into such a wonderful day off.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it feels like all the tension has melted from my shoulders!
It's all thanks to you, Zephyr!

Walking past the academy gates, I spotted Bamboo Memory
and the others with bright, refreshed expressions. Seeing them
made my own heart feel lighter and brighter as well.
